items.source: This variant of validate() supports validation hints, such as validation groups against a JSR-303 provider (in which case, the provided hint objects need to be annotation arguments of type Class).
items.translation: 此 validate() 变体支持验证提示，例如针对 JSR-303 提供者的验证组（在这种情况下，提供的提示对象需要是类型为 Class 的注解参数）。

items.source: Note: Validation hints may get ignored by the actual target Validator, in which case this method should behave just like its regular Validator.validate(Object, Errors) sibling.
items.translation: 注意：实际的 `Validator` 目标可能会忽略验证提示，在这种情况下，此方法的行为应与其常规兄弟方法 Validator.validate(Object, Errors) 完全相同。

items.source: The supplied errors instance can be used to report any resulting validation errors.
items.translation: 提供的 `errors` 实例可用于报告任何由此产生的验证错误。

items.source: Validate the supplied target object, which must be of a type of Class for which the Validator.supports(Class) method typically returns true.
items.translation: 验证提供的target对象，该对象必须是Class类型，且其Validator.supports(Class)方法通常返回true。

items.source:
Return a contained validator instance of the specified type, unwrapping
as far as necessary.
items.translation: 返回指定类型的包含验证器实例，必要时进行解包。

items.source:
Validate the supplied value for the specified field on the target type,
reporting the same validation errors as if the value would be bound to
the field on an instance of the target class.
items.translation: 验证目标类型上指定字段的给定值，报告与将值绑定到目标类实例上的字段时相同的验证错误。

items.source: T - the type of the object to return
errors - contextual state about the validation process
items.translation: errors - 有关验证过程的状态信息

items.source: validationHints - one or more hint objects to be passed to the validation engine
items.translation: validationHints - 一个或多个要传递给验证引擎的提示对象

items.source: type - the class of the object to return
a validator instance of the specified type; null if there isn't a nested validator; an exception may be raised if the specified validator type does not match.
items.translation: 指定类型的验证器实例；如果没有嵌套验证器，则为 `null`；如果指定的验证器类型不匹配，可能会抛出异常。

items.source: Extended variant of the Validator interface, adding support for validation 'hints'.
items.translation: `Validator` 接口的扩展变体，添加了验证“提示”的支持。

items.source: target - the object that is to be validated
